scope: Shared iOS/macOS Library and Search artist inclusion. No production changes.
finding: Library, artist Search and alphabet pages consistently use AlbumArtists. A track-only artist lacking an AlbumArtist relation is not discoverable through this index. An artist with AlbumArtist relations on audio may already appear even without a MusicAlbum item; missing/zero album counts do not establish track-only status.

provider_evidence.observed: GetArtists lacks a standalone/primary-credit predicate. Type filters constrain related items, not performer role. Counts are conditionally copied into artist DTOs.

GetArtists and GetAlbumArtists select Artist and AlbumArtist relations respectively. ContributingArtistIds tests Artist membership absent AlbumArtist membership on an item; it needs known IDs and includes featured-only credits.
artistIds, albumArtistIds and contributingArtistIds filter known identities; they do not discover standalone primary artists as a bounded classification query.

minimum_runtime_change: None until a trustworthy bounded provider distinction or owner-approved narrower policy exists. Do not swap to Artists, infer eligibility from nil/zero counts, parse display names, scan the entire catalog, or fan out per artist.
standalone_definition_gap: A provider identity appearing only in Artist relations can denote either a meaningful standalone primary artist or a featured-only performer/combination. Reviewed server contracts do not distinguish those roles. AlbumCount==0 is insufficient, and nil remains unknown.
